strings.Up to two apps appear directly on the do: Hadi programu mbili huonekana moja kwa moja kwenye gati. Zaidi ya programu mbili hushiriki folda moja inayopanuka kwa kuelea juu au kubofya. Muhtasari unaonyesha programu zote, hadi nne kwa kila safu.
strings.Update verified and ready. Install and r: Sasisho limethibitishwa na tayari. Sakinisha na uanze upya ili kumaliza.
strings.Use OBS app shortcut: Tumia njia ya mkato ya programu ya OBS
strings.Use up to 16 existing local folders, one: Tumia hadi folda 16 za ndani zilizopo, moja kwa kila mstari.
strings.Use your Windows accent or a custom colo: Tumia lafudhi yako ya Windows au rangi maalum.
strings.Use your saved script. Turn off to resto: Tumia hati uliyohifadhi. Zima ili kurejesha muundo uliojengewa ndani.
strings.Uses bundled PresentMon 2.6.0. Some Wind: Hutumia vifurushi vya PresentMon 2.6.0. Baadhi ya usanidi wa Windows unahitaji ruhusa ya kufuatilia. Hakuna ingizo la kibodi/panya linalofuatiliwa.
strings.Uses the active executable, not fullscre: Uses the active executable, not fullscreen mode or a video's frame rate. Other launchers can use an exact executable rule in Profiles.
strings.Uses the same city, units and forecast a: Hutumia jiji, vitengo na utabiri sawa kama wijeti ya hali ya hewa ya kizimbani.
strings.Vertical: a slim rail on the left or rig: Wima: reli ndogo upande wa kushoto au kulia. Mlalo: upau wa kompakt kando ya juu au chini. Maelezo wazi ndani. Unaweza kubadilisha haya katika Mipangilio.
strings.Waiting for a supported game to become a: Waiting for a supported game to become active.
strings.Weather is optional. Only your selected: Hali ya hewa ni ya hiari. Viwianishi vya jiji ulilochagua pekee ndivyo vinavyotumwa kwa Open-Meteo.
strings.Welcome to Nagi. Start with the name you: Karibu kwenye Nagi. Anza na jina ambalo ungependa kuona kwenye salamu yako.
strings.When nothing is playing, open your music: Wakati hakuna kitu kinachocheza, fungua huduma yako ya muziki hapa. Chagua Zote ili kuonyesha viungo vyote vitatu, au chagua huduma moja unayopendelea. Vidhibiti vya uchezaji hufuata kipindi cha media kinachotumika cha Windows.
strings.Windows animation preferences are also r: Mapendeleo ya uhuishaji ya Windows pia yanaheshimiwa.
strings.Windows could not play this file. Check: Windows haikuweza kucheza faili hii. Angalia faili au usakinishe kodeki ya midia inayohitajika.
strings.Windows media session connected: Kipindi cha media cha Windows kimeunganishwa
strings.Windows will ask permission to run only: Windows will ask permission to run only the FPS helper as administrator. It traces the selected application's frame timing. It stops when you disable FPS, close Nagi or close that app.
strings.Workspace app picker: Kiteua programu cha nafasi ya kazi
strings.Workspaces, app docks and visible widget: Nafasi za kazi, vizio vya programu na wijeti zinazoonekana
strings.You can change this later in Settings →: Unaweza kubadilisha hii baadaye katika Mipangilio → Jumla.
strings.Your apps, projects and essential system: Programu, miradi na maelezo muhimu ya mfumo wako.
strings.Your calm desktop companion. Built by Al: Your calm desktop companion. Built by Alaa Eddine Mekkaoui, with a little room for silly.
Jina lako la kuonyesha hukaa kwenye Kompyuta hii.
strings.Your query is sent only when you open th: Hoja yako hutumwa tu unapofungua tokeo.
strings.Your tiny desktop buddy has claimed this:
Rafiki yako mdogo wa eneo-kazi amedai sehemu hii ndogo. Elea kitone cha ukingo ambacho hakijafunikwa ili kuamsha Nagi, au uchague Okay.

EFurahia rafiki yako mpya wa mezani. Tafadhali usiinyweshe maji.
